item.title: Understanding Python Decorators: A Practical Guide
item.description: Python decorators are a powerful feature that allows you to modify or enhance functions and methods. Let’s dive into how they work and when to use them. What Are Decorators? A decorator is a function that takes another function as input and extends its behavior without explicitly modifying it.
